headline: Weathered Expanse Storm Swells as Mooring County Grinds On
war_summary: The newest returns show neither great front abating. In the Weathered Expanse the Colonials have yielded yet another post to no-man's-land, the standing there now one Warden, four Colonial and four demolished, amid a hundred base actions in the day; Wightwalk alone drew forty of them, and Warden casualties, near eleven thousand, again ran the heavier. Mooring County, where the former ruin now counts among Colonial holdings, stands eight Warden to four Colonial after fifty-four actions, MacConmara Barrows and Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest points and two-hour losses above two thousand six hundred. Callahan's Passage, stirring anew, logged sixteen actions about The Crumbling Passage yet kept its ten Warden posts; Stlican Shelf's fighting carried into the small hours around Briar and Breaker Town, and Marban Hollow's Checkpoint Bua took eleven more pounds. Olavis Wake flared at Koskinla before falling silent, Palantine Berm shows fresh movement at the Pippeli Stones, and the Nevish Line's seven-to-one footing continues to absorb a heavy toll. Day 562; thirty-four victory towns demanded; no victor named.
